questions.question: How does the woman describe herself in chapter 2?
options: A thorn among the bushes of the open field
A rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys
A vine climbing the garden wall
A cedar of the heights of Lebanon
questions.answer: A rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys

questions.question: What banner does the beloved raise over the bride?
Chapter 2 contains the line, 'My beloved is mine, and I am his.'
He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was _____.
My beloved is mine, and I am _____.
